title: Portion Management
metaDescription: Discover how portion management can aid in weight loss without feeling restrictive. Use these two simple tricks today!
excerpt: Discover how portion management can aid in weight loss without feeling restrictive. Use these two simple tricks today!
author: Devon RD
bodyHtml:
✨ Portion power without the “diet” vibes ✨
Want to eat less without feeling restricted? Try these two brain-friendly tricks:

🍽️ Smaller plate, smaller fork. Your eyes see a full plate, but you’re actually serving less—easy win!
🔪 Pre-cut your food. Slice that chicken breast (or apple, steak, etc.) before you sit down. Smaller bites = slower eating = quicker fullness.

Tiny tweaks → big results.
Give these a shot today and keep your portions (and goals) on track. You’ve got this! 💪

#WeightLossTips #PortionControl #SmartEating #HealthyHabits #JourneyLite #MindfulEating

 

Devon Price, RD/LD

Registered Dietitian, JourneyLite Physicians

Devon Price is a licensed and registered dietitian who specializes in nutrition care for weight loss surgery and medical weight management patients. With years of experience guiding individuals through their pre- and post-operative journeys, Devon helps patients build sustainable, balanced eating habits that support long-term success after bariatric surgery.
